high_level_description: The image shows a square ceramic tile with a vibrant and colorful floral design. The background of the tile is a bright yellow, which serves as a striking contrast to the intricate patterns and colors of the flowers and leaves. The floral design features multiple flowers with a symmetrical arrangement. Each flower has a central blue section with a textured pattern resembling a net or mesh, surrounded by petals that alternate between red and blue. The petals have a slightly wavy edge, adding a dynamic touch to the design.
